name: Mosaic Security and Internet Services
summary: Security + internet services (atlaswest.com.au, ~1999-2000); renamed Qwestcom ~2001; defunct by ~2004 (ACN 096 994 704).

events.details: Renamed Qwestcom; defunct ~2004. The Mosaic Security and Internet Services brand disappeared from its domain between Apr 2001 and Jan 2002, confirming the c.2001 proposal. rebranded Qwestcom.

refs.label: 1 Apr 2001 atlaswest.com.au still carried the Mosaic ISP identity
By 9 Jan 2002 the same domain had become Qwestcom; last Qwestcom capture Oct 2003
